categories.main_business_segments: Xiong'an New Power Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the energy-saving combustion industry, providing integrated solutions and engineering guidance for energy-saving ignition, clean combustion, and industrial flue gas treatment. Its main products include energy-saving combustion ignition devices, combustion control systems, low nitrogen burners for various boilers, plasma ignition systems, and biomass energy utilization technologies. The company also engages in technology research and development, engineering design, product manufacturing, equipment integration, project management, and technical services mainly for power generation, petrochemical, chemical, metallurgy, building materials, and municipal industrial heating users.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core technologies in automatic ignition, combustion control, and energy-saving combustion, including patented inventions such as spiral pulse low nitrogen combustion methods, plasma generators, and multi-fuel adjustable ignition guns. It operates Asia's largest combustion laboratory for testing and development, employing EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) contracting for project execution. The company focuses on R&D in hydrogen and ammonia gas clean combustion technologies, plasma ignition system optimization, intelligent integrated flame detection, and low nitrogen combustion burners, emphasizing innovation in energy efficiency and environmental protection.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include industrial users in thermal power generation, petrochemical, chemical, metallurgy, building materials, and municipal sectors requiring industrial combustion and heating solutions. Major clients are large engineering companies, coal mining technology firms, environmental protection companies, chemical companies, and boiler manufacturers. The company serves primarily domestic markets within China, focusing on clients needing energy-saving and low-emission combustion technologies.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company's operations and sales are concentrated entirely within China, with headquarters and registered offices in the Hebei Free Trade Zone, Xiong'an New Area, Baoding City. It has subsidiaries and business activities in various Chinese provinces including Jiangsu, Beijing, Shanghai, Guangdong, and Xinjiang. There is no significant overseas business or foreign market exposure reported.
categories.supply_chain_position: Xiong'an New Power Technology operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the energy and environmental technology supply chain. It develops and manufactures combustion and environmental protection equipment, provides engineering design and project management services, and delivers turnkey EPC projects. The company acts as a technology provider and system integrator rather than a raw material supplier or end-user.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on green transformation and innovation breakthroughs aligned with China's carbon peak and carbon neutrality goals. It prioritizes R&D in clean combustion technologies for hydrogen and ammonia fuels, plasma ignition systems, and intelligent flame detection. The company aims to deepen market penetration in flexible coal power unit retrofits and expand new energy applications. It emphasizes strengthening R&D capabilities, accelerating technology commercialization, enhancing cost control, and improving compliance and risk management.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of energy-saving combustion products and integrated engineering services under EPC contracts. The company earns income from product sales, project design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and technical services. It also receives government subsidies related to technology innovation and environmental projects. There is no indication of subscription or licensing revenue models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a pioneer and leader in China's energy-saving combustion and environmental protection sector, with a strong patent portfolio and national awards. It faces competition from large state-owned enterprises, local government-owned companies, and private capital entering the environmental technology market. The company leverages its technological innovation, comprehensive combustion solutions, and EPC project execution capabilities to maintain competitive advantage.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 190 million, a 6.5% decrease from the previous year. It experienced a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 47.4 million, an improvement compared to prior years. Total assets stood at around RMB 756 million, with net assets of RMB 240 million. The company’s cash flow from operations improved significantly, indicating better cash management despite ongoing losses. The company is mid-sized with a focus on stabilizing and growing through innovation and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Xiong'an New Power Technology emphasizes its unique value through advanced energy-saving and clean combustion technologies, including patented low nitrogen combustion methods and plasma ignition systems. Its comprehensive one-stop EPC solutions and large-scale combustion testing facilities enable customized, efficient, and environmentally friendly industrial combustion systems. The company’s integration of new energy fuels like hydrogen and ammonia into combustion technology aligns with national carbon reduction policies, differentiating it as a forward-looking innovator in the energy and environmental sector.
